t: Fortress 9Ltr Slate Grey Shed and Fence Stain delivers essential wood protection and a professional finish for exterior timber structures. This versatile wood stain is ideal for garden fences, sheds, pergolas, and gazebos, providing durable colour and all-weather resistance. Its quick-drying, water-based formula becomes showerproof in just one hour, ensuring efficient project completion. The low odour formulation enhances user comfort, and the easy-clean properties simplify maintenance, making it suitable for busy trade professionals and extensive outdoor renovations.
